faqs.q: Can a service-area business rank in Richmond?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the service area is stated honestly. A business covering Broadmoor and Granville can describe those areas without implying an office on every street.

faqs.q: What should a Richmond page include?
faqs.a: A clear description of your renovation, the areas you cover, how to book a quote, what it costs, and the proof homeowners look for before they make contact.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Richmond at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.a: Reviews are both a ranking signal and a conversion driver. In Richmond, where homeowners compare several home renovators, consistent, recent and genuine reviews often tip the decision.
